requirement:
修复票价计算和座位分配相关的 bug。
票价服务的数据传递存在异常，导致座位分配时价格计算不准确。
需要检查票价服务与座位、订票服务之间的数据流。

details.name: ts-price-service
details.rationale: Price service is the source of price data; bug in data flow likely originates here and affects seat allocation.

details.name: ts-preserve-service
details.rationale: Preserve service orchestrates ticket booking and likely calls seat and price services, so it is affected by data flow issues.

details.name: ts-preserve-other-service
details.rationale: Similar to preserve service, it handles booking flows and may interact with seat and price services.

details.name: ts-order-service
details.rationale: Order service manages orders and may rely on price and seat data, so it could be impacted by the bug.

details.name: ts-order-other-service
details.rationale: Handles other order types and may also depend on price and seat services.

details.name: ts-travel-service
details.rationale: Travel service may invoke seat and price services for trip planning and booking, so it could be affected.

details.name: ts-travel-plan-service
details.rationale: Travel plan service aggregates travel options and may depend on seat and price services.

details.name: ts-travel2-service
details.rationale: Travel2 service provides alternative travel options and may also use seat and price data.

details.name: ts-route-plan-service
details.rationale: Route plan service may compute routes and prices, potentially interacting with seat and price services.

details.name: ts-basic-service
details.rationale: Basic service may provide common utilities or configuration used by seat and price services.

details.name: ts-config-service
details.rationale: Config service may hold configuration for price and seat services, affecting their behavior.
